Annual gross revenue. Based on trailing 12-month AirROI performance of 6 comparable properties and 365 available nights.

How the base case is derived: We combine two independent AirROI methods: the median trailing-12-month revenue of the 6 comparable listings ($98,373) and AirROI's revenue estimate for a 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath, 10-guest home at this location ($90,992). The base case is the average of the two: $94,683. The two methods are 7.5% apart.

Compared with the current summer rate card: 81 Timberlane's published 16-week summer schedule totals $228,000 if every week sells. That works out to $2,036 per night across 112 nights. The rate card is $133,317 above the full-year comp-based base case. Based on AirROI's monthly seasonality for this location, 49% of annual revenue falls in Jun–Sep, about $45,970 of the base case. The rate card's nightly equivalent is 2.5x the base-case ADR ($826). Why the two differ: the rate card is an asking price that assumes 100% of summer weeks sell. The comps are what Airbnb listings actually earned over the last 12 months, including their unbooked nights. Weekly agency rentals like this one are not in AirROI's Airbnb data, so the comps may not reflect this property's own booking history. Use the rate card as the summer ceiling and the comp-based numbers as the year-round, nightly-rental view.

Methodology

Assumptions & Methodology

Comp selection
  • 4-5 bedrooms, sleeps 8-12, lakefront or lake access with dock preferred, rated 4.8+ where enough comps qualify
  • Searched Wolfeboro, Tuftonboro, Alton, Moultonborough, in that order of priority
  • Must have AirROI trailing-12-month revenue
  • Lakefront or lake access with dock ranked first; then rating and review count
Scenario math
  • Conservative: 25th percentile of comp annual revenue
  • Base: average of the comp median and AirROI's location estimate
  • Optimistic: the highest of the comp 75th percentile, AirROI's 75th-percentile estimate and the base case
  • Occupancy shown is the matching comp percentile; ADR = revenue ÷ (occupancy × available nights)
Data sources
  • AirROI /listings/comparables and /calculator/estimate: comp revenue, occupancy, ADR, availability and AirROI's location estimate
  • Published rate card: Published 2027 weekly rates, Yankee Pedlar (winnire.com)
  • Raw AirROI responses are saved alongside this report
